title: Elsie Spices up Ed Sheeran’s ‘Make It Rain’ For Judges’ Callbacks on ‘AGT’: Watch
summary: Simon Cowell, as he so often likes to do, kept the artist and the viewers hanging.
contentText:
There’s nothing quite like a last chance performance to squeeze the tension and ramp-up the nerves.

Elsie found herself in just that position on America’s Got Talent.

Following the Auditions, the Mississippi mom and singer stood at or near the brink of elimination. But she made it through to the Judges’ Callbacks, a special round for those acts who landed three or four “Yes” votes at their audition to show why they deserve a spot in the Live shows.

For her make-it-through moment, she performed a cover of Ed Sheeran ’s “Make It Rain” (originally by Foy Vance), reinterpreting the number with a splash of southern soul.

Simon Cowell was caught on a hot mic, explaining why the 32-year-old’s audition, a performance of an original song, “Forgiveless,” divided the judges and failed to spark him up. “She just didn’t make the connection the first time for whatever reason,” he explained to guest judges Poo Bear and Normani. “And this time it was like, seriously, a completely different experience.”

Elsie was proud of her efforts. “I can leave here feeling accomplished,” she said in an interview, which aired Tuesday night (Aug. 4) along with her Judges’ Callbacks performance, “because he said he wanted me to be myself and I feel like I accomplished that.”

Not so fast. Elsie and her fellow hopefuls gathered, one by one, to learn their fate.

Cowell, as he so often likes to do, kept the artist and the viewers hanging. “I think after that first audition was what we spoke about yesterday was I didn’t quite feel the connection. I think today, from the minute you walked out, you actually lit up the stage,” he remarked. “You have this incredible, almost like peaceful, aura about you. And there is no question of doubt, we will not be making these live shows… without you.”

Cue the tears.

“So, you are joining us in the live shows,” Cowell confirmed, if any doubt remained.

The acerbic British judge also advanced Abiud Sando, Nyjah Music & Zyah Rhythm, Akira, and Travis Garland, while Elekrodads was eliminated. Meanwhile, Mel B advanced Butter & Grit, James & Marina, and Béty, while Lachlan Patterson, Joel M, and Madelyn Tallent & Malachi Martin headed for the exit.

AGT  airs every Tuesday at 8 p.m. ET on NBC, streaming the next day on Peacock.
